message:
Dearest Dawn,

In the grand tapestry of one’s life, few threads shine as brightly as a true best friend. From the very beginning, you have been more than a mere acquaintance; you have been a sister of the heart to Diane and a most valued companion to Chino. You have walked alongside Diane through the changing seasons—from the innocent days of childhood and high school into the complexities of the present.

Indeed, you were a steadfast anchor during her most trying hours, offering grace through heartbreaks and solace during painful trials. This Author—and indeed the happy couple—cannot imagine the curtain rising on this 'happy ending' without you there to witness it. It would be our greatest honor to have you stand beside us as a Bridesmaid, for our celebration would surely lack its luster without your presence.

As this shall be a most intimate gathering of those we hold most dear, a seat has been reserved especially for you at the top of our list. We sincerely hope you shall join us.

We kindly request the favor of a reply via Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr.

With all our love and gratitude,
Diane & Chino
